"Why JARVIS AI Needs Accessibility Services:
" "JARVIS AI controls your smartphone via voice and text commands. Accessibility permission lets JARVIS read the current screen context and interact with apps only when you ask.

" "What This Permission Enables:
" "• Screen Context: Analyze visible UI elements when you invoke Screen Assistant or automation tasks.
" "• Touch & Navigation: Perform taps, swipes, text input, Home, Back, and app switching.
" "• Cross-App Tasks: Launch apps and complete multi-step workflows on your behalf.

" "Privacy & Security:
" "• Powered by Firebase AI Logic with App Check (no embedded API keys)
" "• Screen context is accessed strictly on-demand during active tasks
" "• You can pause or revoke access anytime in Android Settings."
